fusions.name: Steady Trot
fusions.desc: Stamps a quick trot around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Your movement speed rises by 10% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Long-Haul Charge
fusions.desc: A charging blow that deals 28 damage, up to 1.5 times that at its full 6 tiles. Against a boss or elite it also deals 5% of its maximum health.

fusions.name: Plodding Vanguard
fusions.desc: Your stamina recovers 50% faster for 17 seconds. Up to 3 enemies within 4 tiles are drawn onto you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hard-Ridden
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, you gain a shield worth 8% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
